text.card: Color five fixed regions so shared borders never have the same color.
text.hands_empty: Put down what you hold before changing a region.
text.occupied: That region already has a color. Clear it individually before choosing another.
text.shared_color: A region across a shared border already has that color. Choose a different color or clear a region to backtrack.
text.already_blank: That region is already blank. Choose a color or clear a colored region.
text.coordinates: The map is an original square divided into center C and four outer trapezoids: N at the far/top edge, E at the right, S near/bottom and W at the left. Adjacent means a shared positive-length border, not a corner alone. C borders all four outer regions; outer borders are N-E, E-S, S-W and W-N. N/S and E/W are nonneighbors and may have the same color.
text.colors: Blank is value0 and has no numeral. Value1 is red, value2 blue and value3 gold. Each region shows its fixed letter plus the selected color numeral; the three numbered swatches match these codes. Three place forms require that region blank and no neighbor already showing the selected color. One clear form returns just that region to blank.
text.solutions: All six complete solutions in C,N,E,S,W order are (1,2,3,2,3), (1,3,2,3,2), (2,1,3,1,3), (2,3,1,3,1), (3,1,2,1,2), and (3,2,1,2,1). Each uses one center color and alternates the other two around the outer cycle. These are ordinary actions, not a solver.
text.backtrack: A legal dead end has C blank, N blue2, E gold3, S red1 and W gold3. Center C sees all three colors and cannot be colored. Clear S and place blue2 there; then C can be red1. This is individual backtracking, not an automatic reset. Any occupied region may be cleared.
text.limits: Five original fixed planar silhouettes each have mutually exclusive blank/red/blue/gold appearances. Changing a field selects one appearance without paint stock, portable pieces or custody. No fluid painting, precise region finger contact, solver, score, reset, four-color-theorem proof or physical repainting process is claimed.
